command:
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
getL() { awk '/best_log_likelihood/{print $2; exit}' "$1"; }
LI=$(getL iqtree-check.txt); LR=$(getL raxml-check.txt)
D=$(awk -v a="$LI" -v b="$LR" 'BEGIN{d=a-b; if(d<0)d=-d; printf "%.6f", d}')
REL=$(awk -v d="$D" -v a="$LI" 'BEGIN{x=a; if(x<0)x=-x; printf "%.3e", d/x}')
{
  echo "== IQ-TREE vs RAxML-NG: the same ML optimum, two unrelated search heuristics =="
  echo "alignment            Pfam PF26127.1, 114 taxa x 477 columns, LG+G4"
  echo "iqtree_logL          $LI   (IQ-TREE 3.1.3, -T 4, seed 12345)"
  echo "raxml_logL           $LR   (RAxML-NG 2.0.2, --threads 8, seed 12345)"
  echo "abs_difference       $D"
  echo "rel_difference       $REL"
  echo "tolerance            0.010000 absolute   want difference < this"
  echo ""
  echo "Two independent codebases with different search heuristics landing on the same optimum is"
  echo "a statement about the NUMERICS that no single-tool check can make. The tolerance is set by"
  echo "IQ-TREE's printed precision -- it reports 3 decimals, so +-0.0005 of rounding is inherent --"
  echo "not by how close the two happen to land. Asserting 1e-6 would be asserting a print format."
} > crosscheck.txt
cat crosscheck.txt
awk -v d="$D" 'BEGIN{exit !(d<0.01)}'
awk -v v="$LI" 'BEGIN{exit !(v>-54000 && v<-52000)}'
awk -v v="$LR" 'BEGIN{exit !(v>-54000 && v<-52000)}'
echo 'TREE CROSS-CHECK PASSED'
